newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's August electrical output rises 1.91 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's August electrical output rises 1.91 pct.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in August rose 1.91 percent to 1,384 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Wednesday.
Electrical power output in the first eight months of the year was up 2.36 percent to 10,872 GWh, compared with the same period last year, according to a ministry report.
Public service firms produced 1,112 GWh in August while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 272 GWh of the country's total output.
In the first eight months, public service firms produced 8,643 GWh, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 2,229 GWh.

State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power-generating public service firms, produced 524 GWh in August, down 15.99 percent compared with the same month last year. The state company produced 4,258 GWh in the first eight months, off 15.5 percent.
